rows.plain_english: External integrations must live under integrations/ and depend only on the public SDK, never on the API's internal source, and a workspace rule must enforce that. All three integrations are under integrations/, each declares @ship/sdk as its sole runtime dependency, and scripts/check-integration-deps.mjs (run in both CI pipelines and the local factory gate) fails the build if any other runtime dependency appears; TRO-399 delivered it. This sweep re-ran the check (passes), its 10 tests (pass), and proved it fails on a deliberately violating package. No integration source imports api/src.
rows.notes: TRO-399 implements the rule + CI wiring; TRO-448 (Done) added it to scripts/factory/gate.sh. TRO-500 (In Progress) and TRO-496 (Backlog) are boundary-lint hardening for the OTHER half of PF-003 (api/src/platform/api/v1 must not import api/src/routes) — related, not this requirement. Precision on 'enforced': the mechanism is a package.json runtime-dependency check, matching the requirement's literal 'workspace dependency rule'; PLUGFORGE.MD:220 additionally asked for a lint half ('workspace rule + lint') and no ESLint import rule scoped to integrations/* exists (eslint.config.mjs's integrations/cli block carries only general correctness rules) — so a hypothetical relative import of ../../../api/src/... from cli/src would not be caught by the dependency script. Derived (not run): integrations/cli and slack tsconfig set rootDir './src', so tsc would reject a source file outside src (TS6059) — an incidental guard, not documented enforcement. Third-party plumbing (commander in cli, express/@slack/web-api/zod in slack) is imported at runtime but declared as devDependencies — deliberate and documented (CHANGES.md:2706-2708; slack bundles them via scripts/build.mjs) and explicitly permitted by PF-600's wording; read here as consistent with 'import only @ship/sdk' meaning 'no Ship-internal import other than the SDK'.
rows.assumption: 'import only @ship/sdk — never api/src/' is read as forbidding Ship-internal imports other than the SDK (api/src, shared/src, web/src), not as forbidding third-party plumbing packages like commander/express, which PLUGFORGE PF-600 explicitly allows.
rows.delta_vs_prior: upgraded from IMPLEMENTED-UNVERIFIED because the check, its regression tests, and a violation-fails demonstration all ran this sweep (and CI ran them today on identical code); evidence expanded with the three package.json dependency blocks and the documented devDeps rationale
